description: This file defines a controller class 'QualificationLanguageController' that extends an abstract controller, responsible for handling qualification language related views in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It includes a method 'preRender' that initializes a Vue component for the qualification language list.

classes.name: QualificationLanguageController
classes.description: Controller for managing the qualification language list view in the OrangeHRM admin plugin.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component 'qualification-language-list' before rendering the view.
